items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And did Harold Deshawn live in that neighborhood? [INTERVIEWEE] Harold lived in the Southern Water, I'd say yeah.

ctx.x: Like Richard or Ernest McLean and so forth. They lived just a little, if I can remember they lived in the Six Ward on the other side of Esplanade Street.
And did Harold Deshawn live in that neighborhood?
Harold lived in the Southern Water, I'd say yeah. Somewhere around the Neck or St. Anthony or somewhere when he was a younger man.
